meta.description: Hand-curated full-pipeline benchmark for MURENA (Madrid). Same design as benchmark_queries_turin.json: each query runs end to end through all agents; ground truth is the expected agent activation and the regulatory expectation. One language per query (es / en / mixed).
meta.schema: pipeline-v1 (see benchmark_queries_turin.json). id PQ-Mnn. slots.landmark = key of meta.landmarks (coordinates the pipeline's geocoder returns for that name in the Madrid context). rule_family / heuristic_stratum as in downstream_queries_madrid.json; regulatory ranges follow its value_basis.
meta.composition: 40 queries: 25 with an applicable rule, 3 'either', 12 without a rule. Strata on rule queries: {'law_at_or_below_heuristic': 12, 'law_above_heuristic': 13}.
caveats: Author-constructed; regulatory ranges follow downstream_queries_madrid.json value_basis.
Feasibility (non-empty results) is checked on the dataset with the slots as SQL-like filters within 3 km.
The pipeline's geocoder misplaces 'Universidad Politécnica de Madrid' (~12 km north) and does not resolve 'Campus Sur UPM'; neither is used.
changelog: 2026-10-21: PQ-M29, PQ-M32, PQ-M34, PQ-M35, PQ-M36, PQ-M39, PQ-M40 activate false -> either [40, 50]: PGOUM 7.3.4.1 sets a minimum dwelling (40 m2) that does not depend on occupancy, and 7.3.11.2 / FAQ 20.b apply it to a residencia comunitaria as a whole, so a dwelling or student-residence request without a number of people may also be answered with 40 (the decline labels followed the Turin logic, where the minimum depends on the number of inhabitants; inconsistent with DQ-M22 / PQ-M21 'studio for one' = 40). Turin and London set minimums per inhabitant or bedspace only, so their no-capacity items keep 'decline'. Found reviewing the 2026-10-21 study.
